events.title: Demo Update v0.94: Easier tutorial
events.summary: Initial tutorial / First Encounter mission is easier. You now start with more revives. Hold Ctrl to click through the Buildings panel; it no longer blocks the screen outside the panel.

events.title: Demo Update v0.93: Command panel translation fixes
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing the Iron Remnant demo during Next Fest! We noticed some players getting stuck rebuilding the HQ in the Last Stand tutorial. Part of the reason was that the command panel wasn't translated. This update fixes that: The command panel and building menus are now fully translated Clearer feedback when a build button is blocked (barracks and building panels) If you got stuck there before, give it another try. We'd love to hear how far you get on our Discord: https://discord.g

events.title: Iron Remnant Next Fest Live-Stream
events.summary: Join the Iron Remnant devs live during Steam Next Fest! Watch gameplay of the demo and chat with the team.

events.title: Iron Remnant is in Steam Next Fest – play the free demo now!
events.summary: Iron Remnant is part of Steam Next Fest! The free demo is live for the whole festival. Jump in, take command, and let us know what you think! What's in the demo A story-driven campaign opening: the prologue, the tutorial and the fight to retake Sicily from LONGWEI's war machines Real-time battles with your squad: control your character directly, or switch to Annie, Alice and the rest of the party at any time Command an army: build your base, train troops, place turrets and call in orbital strike

events.title: Demo Update: New Story Difficulty & a Friendlier Start
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who’s played the Iron Remnant demo so far! Your playtime data showed the opening was too rough for new Captains, so this update is all about making the first battle more welcoming. Choose Your DifficultyA new difficulty screen now appears before your first battle, with five options from Story to Hardcore. New: Story difficulty. Made for players who want the characters and the story: a shorter battle, fewer enemies, and no heavy mechs or tanks. Easy is also shorter and lighter
